title.en: Providing for the reorganization of the administrative regions in Mindanao, and for other purposes
title.orig: Providing for the reorganization of the administrative regions in Mindanao, and for other purposes

text.en:
REGION IX, to known as WESTERN MINDANAO, shall be reorganized to include the following
provinces and cities:
Zamboanga del Norte Misamis Occidental
Zamboanga Lanao del Norte del Sur
Zamboanga Tangub
Pagadian Ozamis

Dipolog Iligan
Dapitan Marawi
The City of Pagadian shall serve as the regional center. The City of Zamboanga shall remain the commercial
and industrial center.

REGION X, to be known as NORTHERN MINDANAO, shall include the following provinces and
Agusan del Norte Camiguin
Agusan del Sur Bukidnon
Misamis Oriental Surigao del Norte
Cagayan de Oro
The City of Cagayan do Oro shall serve as the regional center.

REGION XI, to be known as SOUTHERN MINDANAO, shall include the following provinces and
Davao del Sur Davao Oriental
Davao del Norte Surigao del Sur
The City of Davao shall serve as the regional center.

REGION XII, to be known as CENTRAL MINDANAO, shall include the following provinces and
Sultan Kudarat
South Cotabato
General Santos
The Municipality of Koronadal (Marinduque) in South Cotabato shall serve as the regional center.

The Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (ARMM) as per the outcome of the November 19,
1989 plebiscite shall be composed of the following provinces:
Sulu Maguindanao

Tawi-Tawi Lanao del Sur
The City of Cotabato shall serve as the provisional capital until such time as the Regional Assembly shall fix
by law the permanent seat of government for ARMM in accordance with Republic Act No. 6734.

The transfer of the regional centers in the reorganized Regions IX and XII shall be effected within
eighteen (18) months from the effectivity of this Executive Order subject to the availability of funds for the

The following committees shall supervise the following tasks to be completed by 31 December 1990.
(1) For Region XII
Mr. Jesus V. Ayala
Cabinet Officers for Regional Development for Region XI
Cabinet Officer for Regional Development for Region XII
Department of Local Government
National Economic and Development Authority Secretariat
Department of Budget and Management Presidential Staff
This Committee shall supervise the transfer of South Cotabato from Region XI to Region XII, and the
organization of the Regional Development Council in the newly reorganized administrative region of Region
(1) For Region XI
Sec. Fidel V. Ramos
Cabinet Officer for Regional Development for Region X
Cabinet Officer for Regional Development for Region XII
Chairman of the Regional Development Council for Region X
Department of Local Government
National Economic and Development Authority Secretariat
Department of Budget and Management
Presidential Management Staff
This Committee shall supervise the transfer of Lanao del Norte and Misamis Occidental from Regions XII and
X, respectively, to Region IX, as well as the cities of Iligan and Marawi from Region XII to Region IX; and
the reorganization of the Regional Development Council in the newly reorganized administrative region of

Regions X and XI shall likewise organize their respective Regional Development Councils as a result
of the transfer of some provinces and/or cities to other regions.

The Committee may call upon any government agency for assistance, and may designate any office to
serve as its secretariat.

All issuance, ordinances, rules and regulations or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this

Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 12th day of October, in the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety.
